claim: Calibration metrics such as ECE conflate sensitivity and bias; SDT decomposition separates models that ECE ranks identically-adequate.
stance_target: F: measurement-instrument framing of calibration is occupied for factual QA
scope_conditions: abstract; three 7-8B models; factual QA only
quoted_support: Signal Detection Theory (SDT) decomposes these components.

breadth.confidence_families: signal-detection decomposition of answer correctness vs forced-choice evidence strength (da, criterion c, z-ROC slopes); force-decoded log-probabilities (Analysis A)
breadth.base_vs_instruct: yes: Llama-3-8B-Base as instruction-tuning contrast (Sec 3.1); z-ROC slopes instruct 0.52-0.63 vs base 0.77-0.87 (abstract)
breadth.elicitation_formats: temperature sweep T in 0.1..2.0; force-decode; no verbal comparison
breadth.benchmarks: TriviaQA (5,000 questions) and Natural Questions/NQ-Open (3,000); no code
breadth.calibration_metrics: AUC, da, criterion c, z-ROC slope, ECE comparison (Llama-3-Instruct ECE = 0.089; Mistral ECE = 0.112)
